Patch Set 1:

(11 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good; the mechanical wbe_* removal and the aops-handler consolidation look correct and I could not find a build or runtime break on any of the guarded kernel combinations. Two hunks do change behavior beyond a code move (fault injection on the ->invalidate_folio path, and the always-on LL_SBI_LARGE_FOLIOS / FGF_FOLIO_MAX_ORDER) - worth confirming they are intended. The rest are optional nits for whenever this is next refreshed.

LU-18687 build: move aops compat code into fs.h

Migrate the aops handlers into compat specific handlers in
include/lustre_compat/fs.h

This also allows us to kill the wbe_* macros
